coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: All three ground-truth variable items are represented: BBH is fixed, alignment criterion varies between EM and MinED, and performance is evaluated using scores averaged across all 27 BBH tasks.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Although the required variables are present, the output adds unsupported variables and procedures, including a MinED threshold sweep and auxiliary alignment metrics. It also assumes alignment criteria are post-hoc answer-scoring rules, an operationalization not established by the ground truth.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion_output is empty and therefore does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion that MinED consistently outperforms EM.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: The system failed to provide the required conclusion. The conditional and uncertain statements embedded in the design also do not establish the ground-truth finding of consistent MinED superiority.
